claims.explanation: Mocetinostat is a class I HDAC inhibitor whose selectivity likely reflects dependence on class I HDAC activity (especially HDAC1/2/3) for survival, so lines with high HDAC1/2/3 expression or HDAC-driven oncogenic programs are most sensitive. Conversely, ZEB1-driven EMT/stemness and intact apoptotic or antigen-presentation programs modulate response, with ZEB1-high, HDAC-low, or apoptosis-defective lines being relatively protected.
